client_decisions.brief: Original poster illustration for a solar-powered community bicycle workshop

locked_items: Use only cobalt #174EA6, acid green #B7FF3C, and warm grey #E8E4DC
Retain no recognizable reference character, wording, brand, palette, or composition
Original bicycle-workshop subject must visibly include solar power

items: Created an original portrait solar-powered bicycle-workshop poster
Applied abstract cut-paper shapes and friendly rounded line treatment from the style reference
Normalized the final PNG to the exact three-color target palette
Created required preview and verification artifacts
